==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*jьskati}}. Cognate with {{cog|bg|и́скам||I want}}, {{cog|sa|इच्छति||to desire}}, {{cog|sh|ѝскати}}, {{m|sh|ìskati||to look for}}, {{cog|lt|ieškoti||to seek}}, {{cog|ang|āscian}} (whence {{cog|en|ask}}).

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|иска́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-искать.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|иска́ть|impf|pf=поиска́ть|vn=иска́ние<q:nomen actionis instantiae>,иска́тель<q:nomen agentis; nomen instrumenti>,ище́йка<q:nomen agentis>}}

# to [[look for]], to [[seek]] {{+obj|ru|acc/gen<someone/something>}}
